target_customer: Founders and operators with heavy email loads, on Gmail, Google Workspace and Microsoft 365
problem: Inbox triage, replying and follow-up tracking consume hours; Slashy drafts in the user's voice and tracks follow-ups.
business_model: B2B SaaS per seat (one review reports about $25 per seat monthly billed annually; reviews disagree)

founders.name: Harsha Gaddipati
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no employers or education. EveryDev says former AWS engineer, single aggregator, not used.

founders.name: Dhruv Roongta
founders.background_notes: Won prizes at CalHacks and HackMIT per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Email sync across Gmail and Microsoft, voice-matched drafting and agent actions are standard engineering with LLM reliability challenges.

defensibility.rationale: Email client habit and learned writing style create some stickiness, but Gmail, Outlook, Superhuman and Shortwave all ship AI features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents shipped AI drafting and triage; reviews in 2026 list Superhuman, Shortwave and Fyxer as the competitive set.

market_need_then: Email overload is a long-standing pain; the 2025 agent wave made voice-matched drafting feasible.

branding.domain_note: Uses slashy.com; acquisition details not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Playful founder voice; 'Cursor for Email' tagline

rebrands.why: EveryDev lists it as a new product vision after pivoting from an AI website builder; single listing source

branding.community_and_virality: Reported #1 Product Hunt launch in June 2026 per a listing site; unverified.

brand_strength.rationale: Rebranded in January 2026 and had little brand history; name is confusable with Slash and other products.

pivots.why: New product vision per EveryDev listing; single source

outcome_analysis: Slashy entered YC as Dash AI, an AI website builder, and rebranded to Slashy in January 2026 around an email client. Listings report 1,000 active organizations by March 2026 and a June 2026 Product Hunt launch, but a co-founder reportedly left in June 2026 and the market is crowded with Gmail, Outlook and Superhuman. Funding beyond a $500K pre-seed is unclear.
notes: Company site fetch was rate limited. The YC page lists two founders; EveryDev lists a third co-founder, Pranjali Awasthi (CEO, said to have left June 2026) and different titles; not recorded as a founder because the YC page does not list her. Pre-seed $500K is in VCBacked, Standout and EveryDev (aggregators only, investor lists conflict), and a seed from Pioneer Fund (early 2026, undisclosed) is only in EveryDev. Unverified. Competitor sources are dated 2026 so none recorded for the June 2025 batch.
